item_gen_gap.title: Generation Gap Smiles
item_gen_gap.description: Capture a heart-warming photo of two family members together: one from the oldest generation and one from the youngest generation smiling!

item_family_heirloom.title: Relic of the Elders
item_family_heirloom.description: Locate and photograph a treasured heirloom, a vintage black-and-white family photo, an ancient diary, or a handwritten recipe card.

item_cousins_selfie.title: The Multi-Clan Cousin Shot
item_cousins_selfie.description: Take a group selfie with at least three cousins representing at least two different family branches or lineages!

item_bbq_boss.title: The Grill Master / Feast Chief
item_bbq_boss.description: Snap an action shot of our champion family chef/grill master managing the food, serving beverages, or cutting the reunion cake!

item_ uncanny_lookalikes.title: Uncanny Family Lookalikes
item_ uncanny_lookalikes.description: Photograph two family members side-by-side who look amazingly alike! Let the AI referee judge the facial similarities.

item_retro_moves.title: Old School Cool
item_retro_moves.description: Get an action photo of someone showing off a fun vintage dance move (disco point, hand jive, twist) or wearing a legendary retro outfit!

item_group_hug.title: Group Hug Extravaganza
item_group_hug.description: A wide group hug or silly squad picture featuring at least 5 laughing relatives in a single shot!

item_reunion_recreation.title: Nature Walk Keepsake
item_reunion_recreation.description: Find an attractive stone, pinecone, five-pointed leaf, or flower right outside our reunion headquarters venue.

item_family_mascot.title: Reunion Mascot/Pet
item_family_mascot.description: Take a picture of any pet participating in the reunion, or a warm plush animal/toy brought by the children.
